notes.title: Level Jam Celebration
notes.content: [h1]🎉Boxel 3D Anniversary and 3k Members Celebration Level Jam🎂[/h1][p][/p][h2]A message from our Discord Server:[/h2][p][i]Starting NOW a celebratory level jam is live! This is to commemorate both the discord server hitting 3,000 members (hopefully for good), and the 5th birthday of Boxel 3D![/i][/p][p][i]Levels are expected to have lengths that range from short to medium-long and have low-medium difficulty. Your level should be themed around the number 3,000 (as a celebration of hitting 3k members) and/or the Boxel 3D public release birthday (July 24th)![/i][/p][p][i]Levels will be narrowed down to about 7-ish by event organizers after the event concludes. Those levels will be played and judged by four [b]@Event Organizer[/b] and scored based on the following criteria:[/i][/p][list][*][p][i]Maximum 10 points for gameplay[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Maximum 5 points for the theme and how well it connects to the theme of the level jam[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Maximum 5 points for decoration/quality[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Maximum 3 points for having a cake somewhere (high quality, creatively hidden for 3, one of them for 2, and it exists for 1, no cake is 0)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Maximum 2 points for a Tiny Tycoon reference (to commemorate the birthday of the game you all chose to ignore) (points based on quality and creativity of reference)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][i]For a total of 25 points per judge and a max score of 100 points![/i][/p][p][i]This winner will receive the [b]@Event Winner[/b] role, a month of Discord Nitro, and their placed level in-game (includes the [b]@Level Creator[/b] role)![/i][/p][p][i]The submission window will close Thursday, July 31, 2025 3:00 PM.[/i][/p][p][i]There is a maximum of two level submissions a person.[/i][/p][p][i]Submissions are to be made in ⁠[b]#boxel-birthday-event[/b].[/i][/p][p][i]Good luck![/i][/p][p][i]Also have fun.[/i][/p][p][i]Or else...[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45411863/36651e092358a09a93098fef01df5082b80c4041.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Free To Play
notes.content: [h1]Boxel 3D is now free-to-play on Steam![/h1][p][/p][p]I want to thank everyone for supporting me both financially and socially by helping others create amazing content on Steam and in the Discord server.[/p][p][/p][p]My goal for launching on Steam was to help fund the cost of developing my games on Steam. We accomplished this goal by earning back the money needed to purchase a developer license/assets with earnings to spare ([b]$315[/b]).[/p][p][/p][p]I look forward to playing all your levels for the years to come and hope you enjoy playing my game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45411863/31802f26be02c56f5d2c5ae641bf05be3c3be01d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Community Event Winners
notes.content:
Congratulations to the 5 winners of the Boxel 3D Level Design Competition!

Submissions and voting were held between March 26th and April 9th, and the results did not disappoint. Thank you to everyone that participated with their time and creativity for all these incredible levels!

The following levels have been added to the official community level pack (v2.5.7)

[list]
[*] [b]The Escape[/b] - [i]by AMiner[/i]
[*] [b]Boxelling Over It[/b] - [i]by Charlieee1[/i]
[*] [b]Boxel Summit[/b] - [i]by Green[/i]
[*] [b]Pizza Time[/b] - [i]by Poktoshi[/i]
[*] [b]Dungeon Escape[/b] - [i]by BoxelBug[/i]
[/list]

Warning! Some levels are crazy difficult lol

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45411863/9b08d1deafadf4a3b01640de476c33b4d62a5d7f.png[/img]

notes.title: Boxel 3D Workshop
notes.content:
[b]Calling all level designers from around the world![/b]

The Boxel 3D Workshop is now live and ready for the most creative level designers to participate. Not much of a designer? Be sure to support your designers by voting or commenting on their creations.

Version 2.5.0 is now live and includes a bunch of features to enhance your creativity and skills.

[list]
[*] Added Steam Workshop integration
[*] Added Workshop UI for publishing levels to Steam
[*] Fixed various multiplayer bugs
[*] Fixed Level Editor axis rotation bug
[*] A lot more minor changes, but it's late, and I'm tired lol
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45411863/d0679d44e1ea39b6667e6ea2f3a18487309b49e8.png[/img]

notes.title: New Level Browser
notes.content:
Speedrunners rejoice! The "Level Browser" menu now includes a bunch of new features that will enhance your level browsing experience.

Key Features:

[list]
[*] Added a search bar
[*] Added level "pack" browser
[*] Added level "info" section
[*] Added speedrun.com links
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45411863/7a12a1f0baa57167c2c691472c32705f6ba62188.png[/img]

notes.title: New Language Option
notes.content:
The next patch of Boxel 3D will include multiple language options for players to choose from.

Listed below are the most popular languages that Boxel 3D players speak (within the last 30 days):

[list]
[*] English: 71%
[*] Spanish: 8%
[*] Dutch: 6%
[*] French: 3%
[*] Vietnamese: 2%
[*] Other: 10%
[/list]

Spanish will likely be the first language to be added to the game. Additional languages will be translated as more players join the community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45411863/d7204bd27a374d0c19a570d19496f0ed5f2d067b.png[/img]

notes.title: New Music Option
notes.content:
Are you tired of playing the same bleeps and bloops while breaking world records? With version 2.3.2, you can now choose which song you want to listen to.

There are currently 4 Boxel songs to choose from:
[list]
[*] Boxel 1 (2013)
[*] Boxel Rebound (2017)
[*] Boxel 3D Classic (2020)
[*] Boxel 3D Pro (2025)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45411863/da3dfb74407ee6eddea6b5b2adc9870726870a89.png[/img]
